clinical_notes.content: Patient Maria Gonzalez, 56 y/o female with Type 2 Diabetes (E11.9) presents for follow-up. Patient has failed both first-line (Metformin) and second-line (Glipizide) oral therapies over the past 4 years. Metformin was discontinued after 6 months due to persistent GI intolerance and inadequate control (HbA1c 8.2%). Glipizide was subsequently trialed for 6 months but resulted in recurrent hypoglycemic episodes (5 documented events, including one ER visit for near-syncope with BG 51 mg/dL) while still not achieving target HbA1c (7.8%). Current HbA1c is 8.5%, indicating persistent hyperglycemia. Patient has maintained a 3-month blood glucose log demonstrating erratic glycemic patterns with both hyper- and hypoglycemic excursions. Requesting authorization for Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CPT 95251) to enable real-time glucose trend tracking and improve glycemic management. CGM is medically necessary given the documented failure of step therapy and ongoing glycemic instability.
